name: Rex Kanyike Masai
circumstances: Shot in the thigh with live ammunition by a plainclothes police officer wearing a baseball cap at 7:00 PM along Moi Avenue. Rex bled out on the street while fellow protesters frantically tried to perform first aid and rush him to hospital. CCTV footage captured the shooting and the officer walking away calmly.
circumstances_sw: Alipigwa risasi ya moto pajani na afisa wa polisi wa kiraia aliyevaa kofia saa moja usiku katika Barabara ya Moi Avenue. Rex alitokwa na damu nyingi mitaani huku waandamanaji wenzake wakijaribu kumpa huduma ya kwanza. Video za CCTV zilimwonyesha afisa huyo akifyatua risasi na kuondoka kwa utulivu.
official_record: IPOA Case Ref IPOA/HOM/INV/045/2024; KNCHR Report 'Day of Shame'. State post-mortem confirmed death by severe hemorrhage caused by a high-velocity bullet.
justice_status: NO ARREST MADE · OFFICER STILL AT LARGE
tribute: Rex was the first martyr of the Gen Z anti-tax uprising. His courage galvanized a nation to reject economic oppression.
tribute_sw: Rex alikuwa shujaa wa kwanza wa mapambano ya Gen Z dhidi ya unyonyaji. Ujasiri wake uliamsha taifa zima kukataa udhalimu.

name: Evans Kiratu
type_sw: Ukatili wa Polisi (Kupigwa na Bomba la Machozi)
circumstances: Struck in the groin at point-blank range by a police teargas canister intentionally fired horizontally into crowds. Sustained catastrophic internal injuries and ruptured organs. Rushed to Kenyatta National Hospital where he succumbed the following morning.
circumstances_sw: Alipigwa kifuani na sehemu ya siri kwa kopo la gesi ya machozi lililorushwa moja kwa moja na polisi katikati ya umati. Alipata majeraha mabaya ya ndani na kufariki katika Hospitali ya KNH asubuhi iliyofuata.
official_record: KNH medical record & IPOA preliminary investigation report. Death caused by blunt force trauma from projectile.
tribute: A hopeful young student who marched peacefully with his hands in the air, seeking a future free from punitive taxation.
tribute_sw: Mwanafunzi kijana aliyetembea kwa amani akiwa ameinua mikono juu, akidai mustakabali huru bila ushuru wa kidhalimu.

name: David Chege
type_sw: Mauaji ya Polisi (Risasi za Moto Bungeni)
circumstances: Shot dead directly outside the gates of Parliament while holding up a Kenyan national flag. Police and military snipers positioned on legislative building rooftops opened indiscriminate live fire on unarmed demonstrators protesting the passage of the Finance Bill 2024.
circumstances_sw: Aliuawa kwa kupigwa risasi ya kichwa mbele ya lango kuu la Bunge akiwa ameshikilia bendera ya Kenya mikononi. Polisi na wadunguaji waliojificha juu ya paa za Bunge walifyatua risasi za moto kiholela kwa waandamanaji.
official_record: KNCHR Protest Fact-Finding Report; Amnesty International Kenya forensic ballistic report.
tribute: Held the Kenyan flag high till his last breath. A symbol of unbreakable patriotic resolve.
tribute_sw: Alishikilia bendera ya taifa hadi pumzi yake ya mwisho. Alama ya uzalendo usiovunjika.

name: Kennedy Onyango
circumstances: Shot eight times by police officers firing indiscriminately into market stalls and residential streets during evening protests in Ongata Rongai. Kennedy was running an errand to borrow a book from a classmate when he was hit.
circumstances_sw: Alipigwa risasi nane na polisi waliokuwa wakifyatua risasi kiholela katika vibanda vya biashara na mitaa ya makazi huko Rongai. Kennedy alikuwa ametumwa kuazima kitabu kwa mwenzake alipouawa.
official_record: Post-mortem by Dr. Peter Ndegwa confirmed multiple gunshot wounds from high-velocity military-grade rounds. IPOA investigation opened.
tribute: A 12-year-old child whose innocent life was cut short by reckless, state-sponsored violence.
tribute_sw: Mtoto wa miaka 12 asiye na hatia ambaye maisha yake yalikatizwa kikatili na risasi za polisi.

name: Erickson Kyalo
circumstances: Shot dead by anti-riot officers while assisting wounded protesters into an emergency ambulance near Holy Family Basilica. A bullet pierced his back and exited through his chest.
circumstances_sw: Aliuawa kwa kupigwa risasi ya mgongo akisaidia kubeba majeruhi kuingia kwenye gari la wagonjwa (Ambulance) karibu na Holy Family Basilica.
official_record: Kenya Red Cross First Responder incident logs & City Mortuary registry.
tribute: A Good Samaritan who risked his life to save his injured peers on the frontline of freedom.
tribute_sw: Msamaria mwema aliyehatarisha maisha yake kuokoa wengine mstari wa mbele wa kupigania haki.

name: Denzel Omondi
type_sw: Utekaji Nyara na Mauaji ya Kinyama
circumstances: A third-year Quantity Survey student at JKUAT. Participated in the Parliament protests on June 25 and posted videos online. Abducted shortly after; his body was discovered floating in the abandoned Mashimoni quarry in Juja on July 6 with deep cuts to his back and signs of strangulation.
circumstances_sw: Mwanafunzi wa mwaka wa tatu wa JKUAT. Alishiriki maandamano ya Bunge mnamo Juni 25. Alitekwa nyara na baadaye mwili wake ulipatikana umetupwa katika machimbo ya mawe ya Mashimoni huko Juja ukiwa na majeraha ya kukatwa na dalili za kunyongwa.
official_record: Pathologist Johansen Oduor autopsy confirmed death by drowning with blunt force trauma to the back of the head. IPOA Case active.
tribute: A brilliant young student whose pursuit of truth and civic dignity was met with cowardly state terror.
tribute_sw: Mwanafunzi mwerevu ambaye kiu yake ya haki na utu wa kikatiba ilijibiwa na ugaidi wa kiserikali.

name: Ibrahim Kamau Wanjiku
circumstances: Shot in the neck by police officers during the infamous Githurai night massacre of June 25, when police opened sustained automatic gunfire on residents and commuters following the day's protests.
circumstances_sw: Alipigwa risasi ya shingo na maafisa wa polisi usiku wa Juni 25 huko Githurai wakati polisi walipofanya mashambulizi makubwa ya risasi dhidi ya raia baada ya maandamano.
official_record: Independent Medico-Legal Unit (IMLU) Githurai fact-finding report; City Mortuary record #1489.
tribute: One of dozens of youth terrorized under the cover of darkness in the Githurai crackdowns.
tribute_sw: Mmoja wa vijana wengi walioshambuliwa gizani katika msako wa kikatili wa Githurai.

name: The Mukuru Kware Quarry Victims
type_sw: Mauaji ya Halaiki na Miili Kutupwa
circumstances: Over a dozen dismembered bodies of young women and youths, wrapped in nylon sacks and tied with ropes, were retrieved by local community youth from an abandoned waterlogged quarry located less than 100 meters from Kware Police Station.
circumstances_sw: Miili ya wanawake vijana zaidi ya kumi na wawili iliyokatwa vipande vipande na kufungwa kwenye magunia ilipatikana na vijana wa mtaa katika machimbo ya Kware yaliyo umbali wa mita 100 pekee kutoka Kituo cha Polisi cha Kware.
official_record: DCI Homicide Division; KNCHR intervention. Autopsies confirmed severe decapitation, mutilation, and strangulation.
justice_status: SUSPECT ESCAPED POLICE CELL · NO ACCOUNTABILITY
justice_status_sw: MSHUKIWA ALITOROKA SELO YA POLISI · HAKUNA WAJIBU
tribute: A grim testament to the utter collapse of state protection and institutionalized impunity in Kenya's informal settlements.
tribute_sw: Ushahidi wa kutisha wa kuporomoka kwa ulinzi wa serikali na ukwepaji wa sheria katika mitaa ya mabanda.

name: Billy Simani (@CrazyNairobian)
circumstances: Abducted by armed plainclothes officers in an unmarked vehicle after using his massive X following to amplify anti-Finance Bill protests. Held incommunicado without legal counsel or medical contact for over 36 hours. Over 50,000 Kenyans joined an emergency X Space demanding his release.
circumstances_sw: Alitekwa nyara na maafisa wa kiusalama katika gari lisilo na nambari baada ya kutumia kurasa zake za mitandao kupinga Mswada wa Fedha. Alizuiliwa mafichoni kwa zaidi ya saa 36 bila mawakili hadi umma ulipopaza sauti.
official_record: High Court Habeas Corpus application; released without charge on June 23 after overwhelming public uprising.
justice_status: RELEASED FOLLOWING PUBLIC UPRISING · NO OFFICERS CHARGED
justice_status_sw: ALIACHILIWA BAADA YA SHINIKIZO LA UMMA
tribute: Proof that citizen solidarity and collective digital voices can force rogue state abductors to retreat.
tribute_sw: Uthibitisho kwamba umoja wa raia na kupaza sauti mtandaoni kunaweza kulazimisha watekaji nyara kurudi nyuma.

name: Shad Khalif
circumstances: Violently seized in South C shopping center by masked armed men traveling in unmarked Toyota Subarus. Blindfolded, handcuffed, and detained in secret torture chambers where he was interrogated about protest funding and leadership for three days.
circumstances_sw: Alikamatwa kwa nguvu South C na watu waliofunika nyuso zao wakiwa na bunduki katika gari la Subaru. Alifungwa kitambaa machoni, pingu, na kuteswa kwenye vyumba vya siri kwa siku tatu akihukumiwa kuhusu nani anafadhili maandamano.
official_record: CCTV footage broadcast on national television showing his abduction; dumped in a forest near Athi River with severe soft tissue trauma.
tribute: Targeted simply for using TikTok to break down the clauses of the punitive Finance Bill.
tribute_sw: Aliteswa kwa sababu tu ya kutumia TikTok kuwaelimisha Wakenya kuhusu vifungu vya kinyonyaji vya Mswada wa Fedha.

name: Gabriel Oguda
circumstances: Daily Nation satirist and prominent political commentator. Abducted from his residence at 2:30 AM by armed DCI officers hours before the Parliamentary vote on the Finance Bill 2024 in a coordinated swoop on civic voices.
circumstances_sw: Mwandishi wa Daily Nation na mwanaharakati mashuhuri. Alitekwa nyara nyumbani kwake saa nane na nusu za usiku na makachero wa DCI saa chache kabla ya kura ya Bunge ya Mswada wa Fedha.
official_record: LSK legal team Habeas Corpus petition; dumped in Machakos after Parliamentary voting concluded.
tribute: His weapon was the pen and satire. The state responded with dawn abductions.
tribute_sw: Silaha yake ilikuwa kalamu na ukweli. Serikali ilijibu kwa utekaji nyara wa usiku wa manane.

name: Dr. Austin Omondi (Ja Prado)
type_sw: Utekaji Nyara wa Daktari Aliyesaidia Majeruhi
circumstances: A medical doctor who organized an emergency blood donation drive and field medic stations for wounded protesters at Sikh Union. Abducted outside the clinic by armed men in an unmarked vehicle.
circumstances_sw: Daktari aliyeandaa zoezi la kutoa damu ya dharura na kutoa huduma ya kwanza kwa waandamanaji waliojeruhiwa. Alitekwa nyara nje ya kliniki na watu wenye silaha.
official_record: Kenya Medical Association (KMA) nationwide strike notice and emergency intervention.
justice_status: RELEASED WITHIN 8 HOURS UNDER KMA PRESSURE
justice_status_sw: ALIACHILIWA BAADA YA SHINIKIZO LA CHAMA CHA MADAKTARI KMA
tribute: Even doctors administering emergency care to injured youth were treated by the regime as enemy combatants.
tribute_sw: Hata madaktari waliokuwa wakiokoa maisha ya vijana walitendewa na serikali kama wahalifu.

name: Meshack Yebei
type_sw: Mauaji ya Shahidi wa Mahakama ya ICC
circumstances: A critical defense witness in the International Criminal Court (ICC) case against William Ruto who revealed extensive witness bribery schemes by Ruto's close agents. Abducted from Turbo; his mutilated body was retrieved months later from Tsavo River.
circumstances_sw: Shahidi muhimu wa kesi ya ICC dhidi ya William Ruto aliyefichua rushwa ya mashahidi. Alitekwa nyara Turbo na mwili wake uliokatwa vipande ulipatikana miezi kadhaa baadaye Mto Tsavo.
official_record: ICC Trial Chamber V(A) public records on Paul Gicheru witness bribery syndicate (ICC-01/09-01/20).
justice_status: UNSOLVED MURDER · ICC CASE CLOSED UPON PAUL GICHERU'S DEATH
justice_status_sw: MAUAJI YA KISIRI · KESI YA ICC ILIFUNGWA
tribute: A grim reminder that state-linked witness elimination and impunity has deep historical roots in Kenya.
tribute_sw: Kikumbusho cha huzuni kwamba utekaji nyara na kuua mashahidi wa serikali una historia ndefu nchini.
